Bank at +2% UNLESS still making new highs, then ride and exit on 1.0% off the peak. Sri's own dynamic-exit instinct. Measured forward-only on the three sessions with a real 30-second tape and no look-ahead: shipped +2/-1 = -37,351 (worst day -37,035); hybrid give 1.0 = +39,206, EVERY session positive, worst +6,030.
